title: ServiceStatusDetails
description: Details of a custom service status assigned to a service order.

created_at.description: The date and time the status was created.

display_order.description: The order in which this status appears in the UI. Null if not set.

id.description: The unique ID of the status.

retailer_id.description: The retailer this status belongs to.

status_key.description: The underlying key mapping this status to a system status (e.g. NEW, IN_PROGRESS).

system_default.description: Whether this is a system-managed default status.

updated_at.description: The date and time the status was last updated.
